ar.title: أرز الشركسية

steps.n1: يقدح السمن أو الزيت ويضاف إليه الحبهان والمستكة لإعطاء نكهة طيبة.
steps.n2: يضاف المرق ويترك حتى الغليان ويتبل بالملح والفلفل.
steps.n4: يوضع الأرز في المرق ويقلب معه شرائح الدجاج.
steps.n5: يترك الأرز على درجة حرارة هادئة بدون تقليب حتى يمتص ماءه ويصير أشبه بالعصيدة.

en.title: Circassian-Style Rice with Chicken

steps.n1: Heat the ghee or oil and add the cardamom and mastic to infuse it with flavor.
steps.n2: Add the broth and bring to a boil, then season with salt and pepper.
steps.n3: Cut the boiled chicken into small slices.
steps.n4: Add the rice to the broth and stir in the chicken slices.
steps.n5: Leave the rice on low heat without stirring until it absorbs the liquid and reaches a porridge-like consistency.

legacySteps: Heat the ghee or oil and add the cardamom and mastic to infuse it with flavor.
Add the broth and bring to a boil, then season with salt and pepper.
Cut the boiled chicken into small slices.
Add the rice to the broth and stir in the chicken slices.
Leave the rice on low heat without stirring until it absorbs the liquid and reaches a porridge-like consistency.
